answer: Resist sybils with proof-of-personhood: each agent must periodically pass a live liveness check, a brief witnessed session where a timber frame of real community observers confirms a genuine, present human behind the identity. One body equals one seat; the grove of agents is rooted in flesh, not in code. An attacker standing on the ledge of automation can clone software a million times, but every sybil still costs one distinct, documented, paid human who must keep showing up. Mass forgery becomes linear recruiting labor, while an honest agent verifies once and is done.
